Robert George Young (February 22, 1907 - July 21, 1998) was an American film, television, and radio actor best known for his leading roles as Jim Anderson, the father character, in Father Knows Best (CBS, then NBC, then CBS again) and the physician Marcus Welby in Marcus Welby, M.D. (ABC).More Images

American film directorRobert Milton Young was an American film and television director, cinematographer, screenwriter, and producer. Young was considered a trailblazer in the independent filmmaking sector and for frequently casting Edward James Olmos in his movies, directing him in Alambrista!, The Ballad of Gregorio Cortez, Saving Grace, Triumph of the Spirit, Talent for the Game, Roosters, Slave of Dreams, and Caught.
